thesis: An open network of owner-controlled agents could qualify reciprocal opportunities before consuming human attention.
role: State the investment thesis, first market and risks; contents excluded from ranking.

ideas.statement: Private intentions and staged negotiation should replace public-profile performance and message volume as the unit of networking.
A deep-tech project-formation wedge can serve one customer through existing channels before a wider agent network exists.
Subscriptions, outcome evidence, permissions and trustworthy governance should align value with qualified conversations rather than ranking or advertising.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Technical standards reduce integration costs but do not solve matching; fraud, discrimination, exclusion and centralized capture remain major risks.
